title: Canonical Textual execution-presentation ownership remediation

promises.text: GradleProgressTracker, DotnetProgressTracker, NpmProgressTracker and GenericProgressTracker are semantic parsers/snapshot producers and do not import or instantiate rich.live.Live.
One ExecutionPresentationController owns normal execution renderer selection and receives canonical semantic progress snapshots plus bounded display output.
Interactive TTY execution prefers Textual when available; presentation startup failure falls back to plain output without changing the process result.
promises.reason: PRES-H01 forbids helper-thread Textual. PRES-H02 restores real Textual ownership specifically for artifact apply through a main-thread parent host; other normal execution commands remain reopened until the general main-thread execution host is delivered.

promises.text: Verbose, CI, redirected/non-TTY, explicit plain, quiet and machine/JSON-oriented execution select plain/non-owning presentation instead of Textual.
Captured process output, durable logs, RUN/EXO execution events, Tasker/HUD projections and progress callbacks remain sourced from runner truth rather than presentation state.
Raw interactive stream suppression is decided by the active presentation controller, not by tracker.enabled or parser ownership.
Tasker/HUD remains a parallel projection subscriber and does not preempt the local Textual presentation controller.
Normal execution cancellation is injected from the runner; the Textual execution surface requires a second Ctrl+C within three seconds before invoking cancellation.
promises.reason: The concrete Textual app retains two-step Ctrl+C confirmation and runner-owned cancellation injection, but the live terminal app is intentionally not hosted by the synchronous controller after PRES-H01.

promises.text: The Textual execution bridge is bounded and non-blocking: presentation backpressure drops intermediate display updates instead of blocking canonical execution, and log lines are bounded.
promises.reason: The bounded queue bridge remains implemented and Pilot-tested, but is not connected to a live terminal driver until the main-thread host is delivered.

promises.text: Timeout and task-telemetry output are routed through the presentation controller while remaining preserved in captured/durable output.
The concrete execution Textual app has a real App.run_test/Pilot integration test for snapshot updates, progress, log visibility and Ctrl+C confirmation; native overlay validation requires Textual.
The remediation roadmap is refreshed in-place and explicitly reopens historical PRES runtime qualification rather than deleting or rewriting prior reports.

Artifact preflight/validation/finalize hook progress uses the same ExecutionPresentationController; GenericProgressTracker remains semantic, raw output stays durable, and cancellation delegates to the hook process authority.

reopened_historical_claims.reason: Textual substrate/widget specification was not sufficient proof of concrete runtime ownership or widgets.
Default Textual TUI selection did not prove normal execution had stopped using Rich Live.
Control-center model/page contracts and once projections did not prove a usable concrete Textual application.

still_open: PRES-R01 general normal-execution Textual main-thread host remains open outside artifact apply; PRES-H02 closes artifact apply only
PRES-R03 shortcut and CLI argument parity, responsive compatibility and broad concrete App.run_test/Pilot qualification
PRES-G2R full remediation-window requalification and historical false-positive closure

Explicit legacy terminal/studio HUD Rich Live renderers remain outside the normal-execution R01 ownership boundary; PRES-G2R/PRES-G3 must either migrate, deprecate, or explicitly qualify those cross-surface modes.
qualification_note: PRES-R01 v2 passed native qualification. PRES-H01 then prohibited invalid helper-thread Textual startup. PRES-H02 v3 is qualified/applied and restores a legal main-thread Textual terminal host for artifact apply by managing the canonical Devtool invocation as a child process; general invoke/validation execution remains reopened.

hotfixes.reason: Native Termux qualification passed; background-thread Textual driver startup remains prohibited.
Native Termux qualification passed for the parent/main-thread Textual artifact-apply host; canonical apply/validation/rollback/commit remains child-owned.
